proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: Teodoro laid a straightedge across our 1924 kitchen floor and showed us the dip, almost half an inch. They fixed the subfloor before the 24x48s. The written readings came with the invoice.
reviews.name: Priyanka D.

reviews.text: I'm an engineer and I asked a lot of questions. Every answer came with a number. The slope to the drain is exactly what they said it would be, and the shower empties fast.
reviews.name: Kenji W.

reviews.text: Herringbone in a hallway that isn't square is hard. They snapped a center line, dry-laid the first rows and showed me before mixing any mortar. It looks straight from both ends.
reviews.name: Rosalind P.

reviews.text: They pulled one tile after setting it to show me the mortar on the back. Fully covered. Small thing, but it told me how the rest was done.
reviews.name: Mateo S.

reviews.text: Heated floor in a cold Rockridge bathroom. They tested the mat three times and wrote the readings on the subfloor in marker before tiling over it. Warm feet every morning since January.
reviews.name: Hollis B.

reviews.text: The estimate listed the square footage, the waste factor and the number of boxes, so I could order the tile myself. Their count was right to the box.
reviews.name: Nadia F.

reviews.text: Three hollow tiles in our entry. They tapped the whole floor, marked every bad one with tape, and only replaced what needed it.
reviews.name: Calvin O.

proof.guarantee: Any tile we set that cracks or comes loose within 3 years gets reset at our cost.
